title: quarantine.json
description: The flake quarantine (design 14.7): tests that run everywhere and record their results but do not gate a merge, until they expire. The file is in the repository, so it is public in a public repository and holds only the test ID, the environment scope, the expiry and the fix item. The evidence (logs, run results) stays in the private store, keyed by the test ID. Executors never edit it: the merge queue refuses a branch that changes it, and an entry without an expiry or a fix item is refused.

id.description: The test's ID, as the project's test report names it (HITLD_TEST_REPORT).

environments.description: Where it fails, when only in some environments: an operating system as Node names it (linux, darwin, win32) or a label from policy flake.environments. Without it, the entry holds everywhere.

expires.description: The last day of the quarantine, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). After it, the test gates again and its still being flaky is a decision for the owner: fix it now, rewrite it, or delete it.

fix_item.description: The work item that fixes it, with the evidence.
